title: [DECODED] No, this ‘handsome’ Duterte grandson is not real
summary: A young Duterte is racking up swooning comments and supporters online. Except he's synthetic.

blocks.text: A young Duterte is racking up swooning comments and supporters online. Except he's synthetic.

items: Lance Duterte, a purported son of Vice President Sara Duterte, is revealed to be a fabricated persona created using AI-generated images, despite gaining a significant following on social media.
Visual inconsistencies in his photos, confirmed by AI detection tools, indicate that the images are not real, and there is no official record of his existence.
The account has been used to promote pro-Duterte propaganda and manipulate public perception, particularly during critical political events involving the Duterte family.

blocks.text: This is AI-generated. Read the article for full context. Report any errors.
Sharp features, styled hair, and easy confidence in front of a camera. At first glance, Lance is your stereotypical content creator. Adding to the charm is his surname: Duterte.
Lance Duterte is supposedly the son of Vice President Sara Duterte and grandson of former president Rodrigo Duterte. This has helped him rack up thousands of swooning comments and online supporters.

And in true Duterte fashion, he is often seen posing with a fist bump for photos at different locations — like Luneta Park and Davao City Hall. If that’s not enough proof of his lineage, he has also been posting photos with his supposed family, like his “aunt” Kitty and mother Sara.
There’s one problem with this almost-too-perfect image: he is not real.
Lance established his identity through his Facebook profile, “Lance Duterte (Official Account),” with over 382,000 followers on Facebook.

blocks.caption: DIGITAL IDENTITY. The Facebook profile of Lance Duterte. Rappler screenshot

blocks.text: He recently caught the public’s eye when he shared his photos posing in Luneta Park.

blocks.caption: HARD LAUNCH. A Facebook post by Lance Duterte showing photos of him in Luneta Park. Rappler screenshot

blocks.text: But a closer look at the images exhibits visual signs that they are AI-generated, such as jumbled letters at the Rizal Monument, the absence of the Torre Manila condo behind the monument, and an inaccurate shadow of Lance.

blocks.caption: VISUAL INCONSISTENCIES. A photo of Lance Duterte in front of the Rizal Monument shows telltale signs that it was AI-generated. Photo from the “Lance Duterte (Official Account)” Facebook page, graphics added by Rappler

blocks.text: ​AI image detection tools Hive Detect and Sightengine rated the image as 99.9% likely to be AI-generated, while ZeroGPT and DeepAI gave it a 91% AI-likelihood score.

​Lance also posted photos of him posing warmly with the Vice President and her husband, Manases “Mans” Carpio, and another set of pictures with Veronica “Kitty” Duterte and Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte. The same AI image detection tools said the pictures were AI-generated, but they were not labelled as AI content on Facebook.

blocks.caption: FAMILY PHOTOS. Screenshots of Facebook posts by Lance Duterte with pictures of him with members of the Duterte family. Rappler screenshots

blocks.text: Supporters of the Duterte family also reposted photos of Lance, echoing the narrative that he is related to the Duterte family.

blocks.caption: ONLINE DEBUT. Screenshots of Facebook posts from other pages about Lance Duterte. Rappler screenshots

blocks.text: But in reality, it is publicly known that Vice President Duterte and Carpio only have three children: Mikhaila Maria (Sharky), Mateo Lucas (Stingray), and Marko Digong (Stonefish).
No official public record acknowledges his existence. His persona relies entirely on artificial intelligence to fabricate a person that does not exist.

Lance Duterte is the latest addition to the AI-generated media surrounding the Dutertes. Rappler has previously debunked AI-generated images and videos designed to draw sympathy and political support for the Duterte family.

blocks.caption: [DECODED] What makes AI-generated Duterte statues so popular online?

blocks.text: These synthetic contents are circulating amid critical political events for the Dutertes: the impeachment trial of Vice President Duterte and the continued detention of former president Duterte at The Hague, Netherlands, as he awaits his trial in the ICC.

blocks.caption: DUTERTE-CARPIO FAMILY. A screenshot of Vice President Sara Duterte posing for a family photo with her three children: Sharky, Stingray, and Stonefish, during her inauguration in Davao City on June 19, 2022. Rappler screenshot from the Inday Sara Duterte YouTube channel

blocks.text: Lance Duterte’s Facebook profile was created on September 26, 2021, serving as an alternative profile for another account named “Lance Kurt Duterte.”

blocks.caption: PROFILE HISTORY. A screenshot of the transparency information of the “Lance Duterte (Official Account)” profile from Facebook. Rappler screenshot

blocks.text: Facebook disabled the latter account on January 27, 2025, after a series of suspensions from 2022 until 2024.

blocks.caption: MULTIPLE STRIKES. Screenshots of posts by Lance Duterte stating that his “Lance Kurt Duterte” account was suspended and eventually disabled by Facebook. Rappler screenshots

blocks.text: The “Lance Kurt Duterte” account featured a different face in its profile picture compared to the Lance Duterte persona circulating today.

blocks.caption: DIFFERENT FEATURES. A visual comparison of the profile photo of “Lance Kurt Duterte” in 2024 and an image of “Lance Duterte” today shows no resemblance. Photos from the “Lance Duterte (Official Account)” Facebook page

blocks.text: Rappler earlier fact-checked a claim in 2020 made by an account named “Lance Kurt Dong Duterte” that accused Tricia Robredo, daughter of then-vice president Leni Robredo, of allegedly sending hate messages to him. The account similarly claimed that he is the grandson of former president Duterte. Both of the Robredos have denied that the exchanges happened, and the account later became unavailable on Facebook.

blocks.caption: FALSE: Tricia Robredo sends hate messages to Duterte’s grandson

blocks.text: The “Lance Duterte (Official Account)” Facebook profile became active during the national campaign of Vice President Duterte and President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. in 2022. It became inactive in 2023, then posted about the Duterte family and the arrest of their ally, Pastor Apollo Quiboloy, in 2024.

blocks.caption: TIDES TURNED. Screenshots of posts by Lance Duterte from 2022 to 2024, indicating a tone shift in commentaries about President Marcos Jr. Rappler screenshots

blocks.text: It became active again in 2025 to support Vice President Duterte and direct online attacks toward the Marcos Jr. administration, specifically after the arrest of former president Duterte over his crimes against humanity case in the International Criminal Court (ICC).

blocks.caption: DEFENDING THE DUTERTES. Screenshots of posts published by Lance Duterte after the arrest of former president Duterte in 2025. Rappler screenshots
[DECODED] How online supporters made a victim of Duterte after ICC arrest

blocks.text: In 2026, the account consistently promoted pro-Duterte propaganda. It recently responded to veteran news anchor Korina Sanchez’s remarks that Davao City “looks left behind,” and posted Davao City infrastructure updates paired with pro-Duterte hashtags.

blocks.caption: PRO-DAVAO PROPAGANDA. Screenshots of Facebook posts by “Lance Duterte (Official Account)” criticizing veteran anchor Korina Sanchez. Screenshots by Rappler

blocks.text: It also intensified its activity by humanizing the Lance Duterte persona with AI-generated content, attracting thousands of engagements from social media users. Posts about Lance have garnered comments from supporters, saying that he is ”handsome” and “soon to be an artist or politician.”

blocks.caption: LANCE’S FANS. Screenshots of comments from various Facebook posts about Lance Duterte. Rappler screenshots

blocks.text: Lance’s online fame has even extended beyond his own Facebook accounts. ​A fan-run Facebook page created on September 26, 2026 now has more than 3,800 followers as of writing. The page actively posts AI-generated videos of Lance, which have amassed thousands of reactions each.

blocks.caption: FAN PAGE. Screenshots of AI-generated videos of Lance Duterte posted by a Facebook page dedicated to him. Rappler screenshots

blocks.text: The Global Risks Report 2026 by the World Economic Forum identified misinformation and disinformation as one of the most crucial global concerns, emphasizing that it is now facilitated by AI. The United Nations’ Independent International Scientific Panel on AI has also said in its preliminary report that AI-driven disinformation weakens the information ecosystem and disrupts democracy. – Rappler.com
